name: Bacteriostatic Water 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol
storage: Store at 2-8 °C, protected from light; do not freeze.
definition: Bacteriostatic Water 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol (BA) is a laboratory solvent supplied as sterile solution. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 3 ml, 10 ml. Grade and composition are stated on the lot-specific certificate of analysis. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the sterile solution at 2-8 °C, protected from light. Documentation includes a lot-specific certificate of analysis. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.
